verdict.rationale: LightSprint documents an option to run the product in your own infrastructure or private cloud. That lets a customer control where data lives, but it is a self-hosting deployment option, not an explicit region or residency selector. It appears only as a single pricing-page line, with no detail on residency guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit region/data-residency selection for the hosted service, documentation of where hosted data is stored, detail on self-hosted deployment requirements, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Run LightSprint in your own infrastructure or private cloud environment to fit stricter security and network requirements.
